name: pf-fix-luck-floors
about: fix-luck-floors against the built packages keys, town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Party Luck on generated floors (mods/hwplib-luck/scripts/HWP/Core/LuckFloors.as, docs/design/luck.md). In town `hwp luck 500` (factor 6); the host keeps the party's average in the run scalar hwp_luck_party, which the level's save carries into the floor's generation and start. On the first bandit_keep floor: the keep's secret room set rolls its extra-room chance at 75 % (the cap), the reward spots log a 100 % blueprint chance (25 % x 6, capped) and their luck-leaning counts, and the fishing hole's run chance is 100 % (30 % x 6, capped). With the keys module, each locked chest logs its lock at the floor factor (a gold one its ace chance, 15 % x 6 capped at 50 %), and `hwp keys` shows the key budget at floor Luck x6.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:luck\] secret room sets on [1-9]\d* floor generator\(s\)
steps.name: the secret room sets were swapped for the Luck one

steps.pattern: \[HWP:luck\] secrets keep_secrets on \S+: party Luck 500, extra room chance 75%: (rolled, max 2|not rolled, max 1), placed \d+
steps.name: the keep's secret rooms rolled the extra room at 75 %

steps.pattern: \[HWP:luck\] floor rewards at party Luck x6: blueprint chance 100% -> 1,
steps.name: the reward spots rolled at the party's Luck: a blueprint for sure

steps.pattern: \[HWP:fishing\] run hole chance 100% \(30% at party Luck x6\): (rolled|boss room)
steps.name: the fishing hole's chance multiplied
the floor's chests locked at the party's Luck
the key budget counts the floor's Luck
